tables.title: Standard curriculum, public health nurses' training schools (Chart 54)
rows: Pathology includes causes of illness, inflammation and tumor.
Includes diet therapy. Cookery A-I & A-II 50; B & C 40
Demonstration and practice: A-I 100; A-II 50; C 30
Includes formulas, nutrition and parent education
Field Practice for Public Health Nurses
Includes 1 month training in Health Center and rural work
footnotes: a/ A-I: Three year course for high school graduates. A-II: Two year course for high school graduates. B: One year course for licensed clinical nurses. C: One and one-half year course for licensed midwives.
b/ Class work is for 5 hours a day, 25 days a month, 10 months a year. Practical work is for 6 hours a day, 25 days a month, 10 months a year.
tables.totals_check: Class work: A-I subject hours sum to 2,000 (printed 2,000, agree); A-II sum 1,250 (printed 1,250, agree); B sum 790 (printed 800, disagree by 10); C sum 970 (printed 1,000, disagree by 30). Practical work hours: A-I 1,600+400+600+200=2,800 agree; A-II 1,200+200+600=2,000 agree; B 200+200+600=1,000 agree; C 800+200+600=1,600 agree. Total Work = class + practical: 4,800, 3,250, 1,800, 2,600, all agree.
warnings: Column B and column C class-work subject hours do not sum to the printed totals (790 vs 800; 970 vs 1,000). The print is very small and I probably misread one or more cells in columns B and C; those two columns are low-confidence. Not corrected.
Footnote b/ figures (25 days, 6 hours) are small print and moderately uncertain; the OCR read 45 days and 2 hours, which is likely wrong.
tables.ocr_check: The OCR read the table as a different, garbled curriculum (wrong subjects, columns and totals) and was not usable.
